node.title: KoalaBear m4 A6 (5,4,2) pair-quotient normal form
node.closure: exact cubic-adjoint normalization over the quadratic coefficient field plus challenge-field pole descent
node.statement: The rigid passport A6:5.1,2.2.1.1,4.2 has an explicit degree-15 normal form over Q(nu), nu^2-nu+4=0, obtained from the cubic-adjoint pencil on the unordered-pair curve of the pinned BelyiDB degree-six companion. Its fibers are (5,5,5), (4,4,4,2,1), and (2,2,2,2,2,2,1,1,1). Both coefficient-field embeddings lie in the KoalaBear base field, and its linear-plus-quadratic order-five divisor splits over F_(2130706433^6). No split active fiber, quartic source-star incidence, m4 deletion, owner charge, endpoint, or row close is claimed.
